vulnerability.explanation: display is mistakenly declared as a png_byte (byte) at line 37 instead of a png_bytep (pointer). It is then assigned malloc(rowbytes) at line 65, which truncates the pointer to a byte, and passed to png_read_row as the third argument at line 95, where a pointer is expected. This results in writes through an invalid pointer, causing memory corruption or a crash. The same mistake also leads to calling free(display) on an invalid pointer in the cleanup paths.
